BG_BATTLE_HYMN.title: Battle Hymn
BG_BATTLE_HYMN.description: Once per turn (at the end of your turn): deal {Damage:diff()} damage, twice as much if you're in [gold]Wrath[/gold].
BG_BLASPHEMY.title: Blasphemy
BG_BLASPHEMY.description:
Your next Attack this turn is played 3 times.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your draw pile.
BG_BRILLIANCE.title: Brilliance
BG_BRILLIANCE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Miracle[/gold] you have.
BG_CARVE_REALITY.title: Carve Reality
BG_CARVE_REALITY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to one or two enemies.
BG_COLLECT.title: Collect
BG_CONCLUDE.title: Conclude
BG_CONCLUDE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Magic:diff()} times.
You can't play additional cards this turn.
BG_CONJURE_BLADE.title: Conjure Blade
BG_CONJURE_BLADE.description: Your starter Strikes deal X+{Magic:diff()} more damage.
BG_CONSECRATE.title: Consecrate
BG_CRESCENDO.title: Crescendo
BG_CRUSH_JOINTS.title: Crush Joints
BG_CRUSH_JOINTS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you're in [gold]Wrath[/gold], apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
BG_CUT_THROUGH_FATE.title: Cut Through Fate
BG_DEUS_EX_MACHINA.title: Deus Ex Machina
BG_DEVA_FORM.title: Deva Form
BG_DEVA_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]{Magic:plural:Miracle|Miracles}[/gold].
BG_DEVOTION.title: Devotion
BG_DEVOTION.description: At the start of your turn, gain a [gold]Miracle[/gold] and draw 1 card. Lasts {Magic:diff()} turns.
BG_EMPTY_BODY.title: Empty Body
BG_EMPTY_FIST.title: Empty Fist
BG_EMPTY_MIND.title: Empty Mind
BG_ESTABLISHMENT.title: Establishment
BG_ESTABLISHMENT.description: Cards you [gold]Retained[/gold] last turn cost {Magic:diff()} less this turn.
BG_FEAR_NO_EVIL.title: Fear No Evil
BG_FEAR_NO_EVIL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you're in [gold]Wrath[/gold], enter [gold]Calm[/gold].
BG_FLURRY_OF_BLOWS.title: Flurry of Blows
BG_FLURRY_OF_BLOWS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, {IfUpgraded:show:3 times|twice} if you switched Stances this turn.
BG_FLYING_SLEEVES.title: Flying Sleeves
BG_FOREIGN_INFLUENCE.title: Foreign Influence
BG_FOREIGN_INFLUENCE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, or play a copy of the last Attack another player played this turn.
BG_FORESIGHT.title: Foresight
BG_FORESIGHT.description: At the start of your turn, before you draw, [gold]Scry[/gold] {Magic:diff()}.
BG_HALT.title: Halt
BG_HALT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Magic:diff()} more if you're in [gold]Wrath[/gold].
BG_INDIGNATION.title: Indignation
BG_INDIGNATION.description:
If you're in [gold]Wrath[/gold], apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: to ALL enemies|}.
Otherwise, enter [gold]Wrath[/gold].
BG_INNER_PEACE.title: Inner Peace
BG_INNER_PEACE.description:
If you're in [gold]Calm[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Otherwise, enter [gold]Calm[/gold].
BG_JUDGMENT.title: Judgment
BG_JUDGMENT.description: If the enemy has {Magic:diff()} HP or less, set its HP to 0.
BG_JUST_LUCKY.title: Just Lucky
BG_JUST_LUCKY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the die shows 1-3, [gold]Scry[/gold] {Magic:diff()}. If it shows 4-6, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_LIKE_WATER.title: Like Water
BG_LIKE_WATER.description: At the end of your turn, if you're in [gold]Calm[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_MEDITATE.title: Meditate
BG_MEDITATE.description:
Put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your discard pile into your hand and [gold]Retain[/gold] {Cards:plural:it|them}.
Enter [gold]Calm[/gold].
You can't play additional cards this turn.
BG_MENTAL_FORTRESS.title: Mental Fortress
BG_NIRVANA.title: Nirvana
BG_OMEGA.title: Omega
BG_OMEGA.description: At the end of your turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to any row.
BG_OMNISCIENCE.title: Omniscience
BG_OMNISCIENCE.description: Choose an Attack or Skill in your draw pile. Play it twice for free and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it. Shuffle your draw pile.
BG_PERSEVERANCE.title: Perseverance
BG_PERSEVERANCE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Magic:diff()} more if this was [gold]Retained[/gold] last turn.
BG_PRAY.title: Pray
BG_PRAY.description:
Gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]{Magic:plural:Miracle|Miracles}[/gold].
Draw 2 cards.
You can't draw additional cards this turn.
BG_PROSTRATE.title: Prostrate
BG_PROTECT.title: Protect
BG_RAGNAROK.title: Ragnarok
BG_RAGNAROK.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Magic:diff()} times. Each hit can target a different enemy.
BG_REACH_HEAVEN.title: Reach Heaven
BG_REACH_HEAVEN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals {Magic:diff()} more for each [gold]Miracle[/gold] you have.
BG_RUSHDOWN.title: Rushdown
BG_RUSHDOWN.description: The first time you enter [gold]Wrath[/gold] each turn, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
BG_SANDS_OF_TIME.title: Sands of Time
BG_SANDS_OF_TIME.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals {Magic:diff()} more for each other card with [gold]Retain[/gold] in your hand.
BG_SASH_WHIP.title: Sash Whip
BG_SASH_WHIP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you're in [gold]Calm[/gold], apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
BG_SCRAWL.title: Scrawl
BG_SIGNATURE_MOVE.title: Signature Move
BG_SIGNATURE_MOVE.description:
Can only be played if this is the only Attack in your hand.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
BG_SIMMERING_FURY.title: Simmering Fury
BG_SIMMERING_FURY.description: In [gold]Wrath[/gold], your Attacks deal {Magic:diff()} more damage per hit.
BG_SPIRIT_SHIELD.title: Spirit Shield
BG_SPIRIT_SHIELD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each other card in your hand.
BG_STUDY.title: Study
BG_STUDY.description: At the start of your turn, if you're in [gold]Calm[/gold], draw 2 cards.
BG_SWIVEL.title: Swivel
BG_SWIVEL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: to any player|}.
The next Attack you play this turn costs 0.
BG_TALK_TO_THE_HAND.title: Talk to the Hand
BG_TALK_TO_THE_HAND.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Miracle[/gold] you have.
BG_TANTRUM.title: Tantrum
BG_TANTRUM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {IfUpgraded:show:twice|}.
Enter [gold]Wrath[/gold].
Put this card on top of your draw pile.
BG_THIRD_EYE.title: Third Eye
BG_TRANQUILITY.title: Tranquility
BG_VAULT.title: Vault
BG_VAULT.description:
Discard all cards without [gold]Retain[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BG_WALLOP.title: Wallop
BG_WALLOP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the unblocked damage dealt.
BG_WEAVE.title: Weave
BG_WEAVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you would discard this while [gold]Scrying[/gold], play it instead; it deals {Magic:diff()} more damage.
BG_WINDMILL_STRIKE.title: Windmill Strike
BG_WINDMILL_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals {Magic:diff()} more if this was [gold]Retained[/gold] last turn.
BG_WISH.title: Wish
BG_WORSHIP.title: Worship
BG_WREATH_OF_FLAME.title: Wreath of Flame
BG_WREATH_OF_FLAME.description:
Gain X [gold]Strength[/gold].
Lose it at the end of your turn.
